name: runChecks
reason: runChecks is perch doctor: each catch turns a failed probe into the failed check line doctor prints, so the failure is reported rather than lost.

name: createSystemOne.ask
reason: ask returns the endpoint's answers merged with the single-option choices it settled locally; every question id it was given has an answer.

name: createSystemOne.askAll
reason: The shared state askAll changes is the first-answer gate: one ask sends while the rest wait, and a failed first ask clears it for the next. Covered by the concurrent-asks test in test/systemone.test.js.

name: createSystemOne.askAll.send
reason: send halves a refused batch with Math.ceil and throws at one question; every question lands in exactly one half. Unchanged from main.

name: createCloudClient.fetchImpl
reason: fetchImpl is only called by createSystemOne, which always sends a JSON body, so options.body is never missing.

name: wrap
reason: wrap returns the help text wrapped at 80 columns, leaving blank lines and indented examples as written; the CLI help tests check its output.

name: liveCounters.draw
reason: draw returns nothing by design: it writes the counters still running to the live line, or the last one when all are done.

name: createCloudClient.fetchImpl
reason: createSystemOne always passes options with a body, and cloudRequest throws rather than return a null scan; it read 51% on main before this PR

name: ok
reason: No catch in this method. It builds a passing line of perch doctor's output; the catches the reading saw are in runChecks.

name: bad
reason: No catch in this method. It builds a failing line of perch doctor's output; the catches the reading saw are in runChecks.

name: runChecks
reason: runChecks is perch doctor: each catch turns a failed probe into the failed check line doctor prints, so the failure is reported rather than lost.

name: cloudRequest
reason: The null from a body that does not parse is checked below it: a failed status throws with the status, and a success with no body throws 'invalid response'.

name: actionsToken
reason: The {} from a body that does not parse has no value, so the next line throws the OIDC error.

name: ownQuestions
reason: Outside a git repository there is no perch.yaml to put in force; perch issues still lists what --out holds.

name: doctor
reason: doctor has to answer outside a git repository. It falls back to the current directory, and runChecks reports that it is not in a repository.

name: readIgnored
reason: The catches stand for a perch.yaml that is not there: the working copy's, else the commit's, else none. Parsing is outside them, so a file that does not parse still fails the run.

name: readScanTypes
reason: The catches stand for a perch.yaml that is not there: the working copy's, else the commit's, else none and the defaults apply. Parsing is outside them, so a file that does not parse still fails the run.

name: readRuleFiles
reason: The catches stand for files that are not there: no .perch/rules directory, or a rule file in neither the working copy nor the commit. Parsing is in readRules, outside them, so a broken rule file still fails.

name: readRuleFiles.wanted
reason: No catch in this method. It is the path test readRuleFiles filters with.

name: runContext
reason: GitHub writes the event file for every job. Without one there is no pull request head to report, and the checkout revision is the commit that was scanned.

name: resolveOut
reason: Outside a git repository .perch goes under the working directory, as the method's comment says.

name: openStore
reason: openStore builds the store object. The catches the reading saw belong to its methods, each closed on its own.

name: openStore.exclude
reason: A .gitignore that cannot be read is written over; a write that fails throws.

name: openStore.startLog
reason: startLog creates the log without a catch, so a log that cannot be written fails the run there. A later line that fails to append must not fail the scan it describes.

name: openStore.tail
reason: doctor shows the end of the last run's log. With no log there is no run to show, and doctor still has to answer.

name: originUrl
reason: A repository with no origin remote is ordinary. null says there is none, and resolveTarget reads it as not on GitHub.

name: removeWorktree
reason: Cleanup. A worktree git will not remove is deleted by hand, and rm throws if that fails. addWorktree runs the prune again, uncaught, right after.

name: remoteRepositoryName
reason: A remote URL that does not parse is one it cannot name: the same null as every other shape it does not recognize.

name: repositoryForLogin
reason: git config --get exits 1 when there is no origin remote, the ordinary case of a local-only repository. The scan runs without registering one.

name: filesDefining
reason: A repository with no commits has no revision; its rule files are read off disk alone.
